title: C: CRDT Counter (G-Counter)
description: Implement a Grow-Only Counter (G-Counter) CRDT that can be merged across multiple nodes.

steps.title: G-Counter Implementation
steps.description: Define a `GCounter` struct with an int array for each node's contribution. Write `void increment(GCounter *c, int node)` and `int value(GCounter *c)` which sums all node counts. Write `void merge(GCounter *a, GCounter *b)` that takes the max for each node. Test with 2 nodes.
hints: Each node has its own counter that only goes up.
Value = sum of all node counters.

verification.failureMessage: Increment, merge, and compute the correct merged value
